title: Cookbook
description: The master document for the entire cookbook, assembling bibliographic metadata, front matter, structured content, and back matter.

PressQuote.title: Press Quote
PressQuote.description: A single critical quotation about the cookbook from a named publication.

text.description: The full text of the quoted review.

source.description: The name of the publication the quote is drawn from.

_id.description: The unique database identifier for this document (e.g., 'cookbook').

title.description: The main title of this digital cookbook project.

authors.description: The editors or authors responsible for this digital edition.

language.description: The language of the cookbook text (e.g., 'English').

source.description: Bibliographic details of the original source publication.

title.description: The original title of the work.

authors.description: The original author or authors of the work.

edition.description: The specific edition of the source (e.g., 'New and Revised Edition').

publisher.description: The name of the original publisher.

location.description: The city where the original work was published.

url.description: URL of the source text (e.g., the Project Gutenberg page).

press.description: Contemporary press opinions about the original work.

title.description: The heading under which the press quotes are presented (e.g., 'Some Press Opinions').

preface.description: The author's preface, as an ordered list of paragraph strings.

chapters.description: The full text of the cookbook organized as chapters, each broken into sections that reference entries by identifier.
